name: In-Scattering Integral Approximation via Riemann Sum
definition: A technique to approximate the continuous influx of light energy scattered toward the eye (in-scattering) along a camera ray segment by discretizing the integral into a sum of small rectangular areas.
summary: This method approximates the in-scattering integral for non-homogeneous volumes by summing rectangular areas of sampled radiance, explicitly using auxiliary light rays and Beer's law to evaluate the in-scattering term.
